# `aube cache list`

- **Usage:** `aube cache list [PATTERNS]…`
- **Effect:** read-only

List the available packages in the metadata cache.

Optional glob filters narrow the result; with no filter every cached package is listed.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube cache list '@babel/*'
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/registry-auth) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`[PATTERNS]…`** — Optional glob patterns to filter the listing.

  With no patterns, every cached package is printed.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
